SYMPTOM: Build error 'invalid redeclaration of FlowLayout' when adding Views/Exercises/Components/FlowLayout.swift
CAUSE: ScenarioDetailView.swift has a `private struct FlowLayout` — despite being private, Swift sees both in the same module and complains
FIX: Renamed our component to ExerciseFlowLayout in FlowLayout.swift and all 3 usage sites (HighlightWordsExerciseView, WordBankExerciseView, FillTemplateExerciseView)
PREVENT: Any new layout helper views in the exercise system should use Exercise prefix to avoid future collisions
